notes: Read all 391 source lines before editing. Preserved the full public contract verbatim: the module docstring intent (L1-39), the EditableTextVariant union (L56), EditableTextDisplayProps {value,onStartEdit,disabled} (L58-65), and EditableTextProps {value,onSave,validate?,placeholder?,maxLength?,ariaLabel,variant?='body',disabled?=false,display?} (L67-107). The DOM-only `className` outer-wrapper prop (L106) becomes `style` (StyleProp<ViewStyle>) plus an added optional `testID`.

Ported the normalise() trim helper (L109-112) and the entire commit state machine unchanged: the editing/draft/saving/error state (L131-134), inputRef/savingRef/lastSubmittedRef refs (L136-140), the not-editing draft re-sync effect (L145-149), startEdit (L151-157), cancelEdit with savingRef guard (L159-164), and commitDraft's single path (L171-231) — no-op exit on trim equality, built-in empty i18n error, optional validator gating, identical-resubmit guard via lastSubmittedRef, savingRef/setSaving toggling, the announce-on-success, and the catch branch that keeps the error + refocuses via a resolved-promise microtask (Promise.resolve().then) — the native-safe equivalent of the web queueMicrotask, since this TS lib config does not expose queueMicrotask.

input onChange (L233-253) -> onChangeText(next:string) keeping the live-validation branch (empty stays silent until commit, else validate). input onKeyDown Enter/Escape (L255-269) -> onKeyPress reading nativeEvent.key for hardware keyboards, PLUS onSubmitEditing for the mobile soft-keyboard return key; both route through the one idempotent commitDraft, with savingRef/lastSubmittedRef preventing any double-save. handleInputBlur (L271-277) preserved 1:1 (stay editing while error, else commit).

Edit-mode render (L296-343): DOM <input> -> controlled <TextInput> (value/onChangeText, editable={!saving}, autoFocus, placeholder, placeholderTextColor, maxLength, accessibilityLabel=ariaLabel, testID='editable-text-input'); the CSS spinner span role='status' (L327-334) -> <ActivityIndicator> with the same 'Saving…' a11y label and testID='editable-text-spinner'; <ErrorText id role='alert'> (L336-340, ./Typography import L54) -> <AppText tone='danger' accessibilityRole='alert' accessibilityLiveRegion='assertive' nativeID>. aria-busy (L316) -> accessibilityState={{busy}}; the rose-400 error border (L324) -> colors.danger border style.

Display modes (L345-388): the custom `display` render prop (L348-354) is invoked with {value,onStartEdit:startEdit,disabled} inside a row View (web <span>); the default button-styled-as-text (L361-388, DOM <button>) -> <Pressable accessibilityRole='button' accessibilityLabel=ariaLabel accessibilityState={{disabled}} onPress={startEdit} testID='editable-text-trigger'> with the visibleText/isPlaceholder logic (L358-359) and numberOfLines={1} for the truncate. The web wired BOTH onClick and onDoubleClick to startEdit, so a single native press = enter edit.

Replaced imports with native-safe equivalents: react-i18next useTranslation (L49) -> useNativeTranslationFallback with {{token}} interpolation so t('editableText.announce.saved','{{label}} saved',{label:ariaLabel}) (L214-216) resolves; useAnnouncer (L53) -> a useMemo({announce}) shim backed by the parity a11y AnnouncerRegion.announce; lucide <Pencil/> (L50, L382-385) -> a small muted decorative text glyph; cn (L52) -> StyleSheet style arrays; EditableText.displayName='EditableText' kept (L391).

Browser-only affordances with no native analog are documented per rule 7: the display-surface F2 keydown shortcut (handleDisplayKeyDown L279-289) is dropped because RN Pressable exposes no cross-platform key handler — Enter/Space activation still works via the button role + onPress, exactly as the web comment notes for those keys. aria-invalid (L314) and aria-describedby (L315) have no RN equivalent, so the error is associated via nativeID + an assertive alert role instead. The lucide pencil's :hover opacity reveal (L384) has no native :hover, so the glyph is shown persistently as the touch affordance.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported — only React, React Native primitives (TextInput/Pressable/View/ActivityIndicator/StyleSheet), and existing apps/native AppText + theme tokens + the parity AnnouncerRegion. Verified with `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint -- --quiet`, and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` (added __tests__/EditableText.test.tsx covering enter/exit edit, trimmed save + announce, no-op exit, empty + validator gating, Escape cancel, blur-while-error, the custom display prop, and the disabled surface).
